patch.value: CHANGELOG omits the shipped --link-deps feature and mislabels 2026.7.23 work as Unreleased

Found during a fleet-wide pm-changelog default-output parity audit. The last regeneration ran with stale local tags and before pm-github-hdai was closed, so the published CHANGELOG.md (a) never listed the --link-deps import feature that actually shipped in npm 2026.7.23, and (b) filed pm-github-wpit under '## Unreleased'. Both items closed before the v2026.07.23 tag boundary (hdai 2026-07-22T23:10:49Z, wpit 2026-07-22T19:41:58Z vs tag committer date 2026-07-23T06:12:30Z), so both belong to the 2026.7.23 section. Fix: git fetch --tags --force then npm run changelog:full. Root cause is the recurring stale-local-tags trap, not a pm-changelog defect (verified: the local build and the published build produce byte-identical output here).

message: File the missing changelog entry found during the fleet parity audit

The published changelog credits the --link-deps import feature to the release that shipped it, and changelog:check stays green.
